candidates.change_summary: Replace body to perform withdraw to a fixed smaller amount (0) instead of withdrawing full balance, changing resulting contract balance after withdrawAll.
Replace onlyOwner modifier's require so it allows any caller (remove access control) which can change who can call withdrawAll and thus change observed behavior after its call.
Replace transfer to send (returns bool) and require success — changes behavior when gas stipends or revert semantics differ.
Remove the require check so withdraw no longer restricted to owner (onlyOwner becomes empty), changing who can call withdraw and thus observable balance transfers.
Replace the call that forwards value with a transfer to _target, which reverts on failure instead of returning a boolean.
Replace the call with a low-level call that ignores the returned boolean (removing the require), so failed sends will not revert.
Change the target of the call to msg.sender instead of the provided _target, causing funds to be sent back to the caller rather than the specified address.
Modify the onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), so sendMoney can be called by non-owners and thus change who triggers balance transfers.
